instruction: Extract the minimum publication year from the spreadsheet and output it to /home/user/oldest_year.txt.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding the oldest paper by publication date. Verified from Excel data (column C): Row 4 'Attention Is All You Need' published 2017/6/12 is the oldest, followed by 2018/2/15, 2018/4/20, 2018/10/11, 2019/9/23. Oldest year: 2017.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads from the specified file path (/home/user/oldest_year.txt) as required by the instruction
Getter extracts year using appropriate regex pattern that covers the expected range (2017-2023)
Metric performs correct exact integer comparison for year matching
Expected value (2017) is semantically correct and matches the metadata explanation of the oldest paper
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the single requirement (oldest year written to file)
Data flow is correct: file content -> extract year -> compare with expected
No postconfig needed since file write operation persists after task completion
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Regex pattern \b(201[7-9]|202[0-3])\b only matches years 2017-2023. Consider a more general pattern like \b(19|20)\d{2}\b for broader year range support, though current pattern works correctly for this specific task
